performanceLimit: Overall average includes slower native final destruction; no whole-game performance claim. Acceptance measures the new spell and combat separately.

entries.title: Luminaire / chest charge, rising field and upper side escapes
entries.note: Live native Furious final-main-life checkpoint: full5330HP and intact limbs; prior copies cleared before filming. Invulnerable input-only bot uses ordinary movement to alternate upper side pockets during Luminaire, then resumes fighting. No recorder HP/phase/clock writes. Both safe routes separately pass without GOD on Normal/Hard/Furious. Shows native main-life defeat and opening final destruction.
